meta.title: Online counselling in Malayalam & English
meta.description: Private online counselling and therapy in Malayalam and English, by video or audio, for Malayalis in Kerala and around the world.

common.comingSoon: This page is coming in a later phase.
common.notFoundBody: It may have moved, or the link may be out of date.

crisis.title: We are not a crisis service
crisis.body: If you or someone near you is in danger, or thinking about ending their life, please reach out right now. These lines are free and open all day and night.
crisis.abroad: Outside India? Please call your local emergency number.

footer.tagline: Counselling in Malayalam and English, from wherever you are.
footer.disclaimer: We offer counselling and psychotherapy. We do not diagnose, prescribe medication or provide emergency care.

hero.title: Talk to someone who understands, in the language you feel in.
hero.lead: Private sessions by video or audio, with counsellors who speak your language — wherever in the world you are.

mood.title: How are you feeling today?
mood.lead: Choose whatever feels closest. There's no wrong answer, and nothing you pick here is saved or shared.
mood.prompt: Pick one and we'll show you where you might begin.
mood.readyBody: A first session is 50 minutes, by video or audio, in Malayalam or English.
mood.crisis: Feeling unsafe right now? Please call {name}, free and 24×7:

services.title: Support for you, and the people around you
services.photoCaption: Sessions by video or audio, from wherever you are.

how.title: Four small steps, at your own pace
how.step1Body: Pick a service and a language. Malayalam, English, or a mix of both — whatever feels natural to you.
how.step2Body: Browse therapists yourself, or tell us a little and we'll suggest someone suited to you.
how.step3Body: Meet by video or audio from somewhere private. If you'd rather not be on camera, you don't have to be.
how.step4Body: Go at your own pace, and book follow-up sessions whenever you're ready.

therapists.title: People who listen, in your language
therapists.lead: Find someone whose experience, language and approach feel right for you.
therapists.credentialsNote: [Verified credentials — RCI registration, qualifications — will appear on every profile.]

breath.title: Take a breath with us
breath.lead: Breathe in as the circle grows, and slowly out as it softens. Four seconds in, six seconds out.
breath.still: In for four, out for six.

testimonials.title: What people tell us
testimonials.note: These are placeholders. Real testimonials will appear only with written consent.

business.title: Wellbeing programmes for workplaces and campuses
business.lead: Confidential counselling for your people, plus workshops in Malayalam and English, shaped around your team or students.
business.workBody: Employee counselling, manager training and workshops on stress and burnout.
business.campusBody: Student counselling, sessions on exam stress, and support for teaching staff.
business.cta: Talk to us about a programme

cta.title: Whenever you're ready, we're here.
cta.lead: Your first step can be a small one. Book a session, or just look around for now.
cta.whatsapp: Prefer to message? Reach us on WhatsApp
cta.someone: Booking for someone you care about? You can book on their behalf, with their agreement.

styleguide.sample: Calm, grounded and human. A space to breathe before you begin.
styleguide.cardBody: One-to-one sessions at your pace, about whatever is on your mind.
styleguide.fieldNameError: Please enter a name, so we know what to call you.

servicesPage.metaDescription: Individual, couples, teen and family therapy online, in Malayalam and English.
servicesPage.title: Find the kind of support that fits
servicesPage.lead: Every session is online, private, and in the language you're most comfortable in.
servicesPage.teens1: A parent or guardian gives consent when booking.
servicesPage.teens2: In the first session, the therapist agrees with you both what stays private and what may be shared.
servicesPage.teens3: If there's a serious safety concern, guardians will be told. This is explained at the very start.
servicesPage.every2Body: Stay off camera if you prefer.
servicesPage.every3Body: Confidential, from anywhere you feel safe.
servicesPage.notSureBody: Start with an individual session. If couples or family sessions would help, your therapist can suggest them later.

concernsPage.metaDescription: Plain-language guides to anxiety, depression, relationships, burnout and more, and how therapy can help.
concernsPage.title: What's on your mind?
concernsPage.lead: Short, plain-language guides to common struggles. Read at your own pace. You don't need a label before you reach out.
concernsPage.notListed: Don't see what you're going through?
concernsPage.notListedBody: That's okay. Therapists can support you with many other concerns too. Book a session and explain in your own words.
concernsPage.signsNote: Everyone's experience is different. This isn't a checklist for diagnosis.
concernsPage.ctaBody: You don't need to have it all figured out. A first session is simply a place to start.
concernsPage.scaffoldNote: [Full guide still to be written. This page uses the standard template until then.]
concernsPage.genericHelp: A therapist offers a private, non-judgemental space to talk about what you're going through, understand it better, and find practical ways forward, at your own pace.

therapistsPage.metaDescription: Browse counsellors and therapists who speak Malayalam and English. Filter by language, concern, session type and availability.
therapistsPage.title: Find someone you feel at ease with
therapistsPage.lead: Use the filters, or let us suggest someone. Nothing you choose here is saved or added to the web address.
therapistsPage.placeholderNote: [These are placeholder profiles. Real therapists will be added before launch.]
therapistsPage.empty: No one matches all of these yet. Try removing a filter, or let us match you.
therapistsPage.credentialsBody: [Degrees, RCI registration number and professional memberships, to be supplied and verified.]

booking.metaDescription: Book an online counselling session in Malayalam or English. Choose a service, a therapist and a time that suits you.
booking.title: Book a session
booking.lead: A few short steps. You can go back at any point, and nothing is final until you send your request.
booking.serviceTitle: What kind of session would you like?
booking.therapistTitle: Who would you like to talk to?
booking.matchBody: Not sure who to choose? Pick a language and a time, and we'll suggest a therapist who suits you.
booking.noTherapists: No therapists offer this session type yet. Please choose another service or let us match you.
booking.timezone: Times are shown in your time zone ({tz}).
booking.noSlotsDay: No open times on this day.
booking.noSlots: No open times in the next three weeks. Try another therapist, or let us match you.
booking.mockNote: [Demo availability. Real times will come from each therapist's calendar.]
booking.mode: How would you like to meet?
booking.detailsLead: We only ask for what we need to arrange your session.
booking.someoneAgree: They know about this booking and agree to it.
booking.name: Name
booking.nameHint: A first name or nickname is fine.
booking.contactHint: Give at least one. We'll use it only to confirm and remind you about sessions.
booking.whatsappOk: You can message me on WhatsApp about this booking.
booking.guardianLead: Teen sessions need a parent or guardian's consent. Please fill this in together.
booking.guardianContact: Parent or guardian's phone or email
booking.guardianConsent: I am the parent or legal guardian, and I consent to these sessions as described in the Minor Protection Policy.
booking.under13: For children under 13, please contact us directly.
booking.consentTerms: I have read and agree to the Terms of Use, the Therapy Agreement and the Privacy Policy.
booking.consentData: I agree that these details may be used to arrange and provide my sessions, as explained in the Privacy Policy.
booking.consentCrisis: I understand this is not an emergency service.
booking.privacy1: Only the people arranging your session, and your therapist, can see them.
booking.privacy2: We never sell them or share them for advertising.
booking.privacy3: You can ask us to see, correct or delete them at any time.
booking.privacy4: We don't ask what you're going through here. You can share that with your therapist, in your own time.
booking.payNote: [Online payment (Razorpay) is coming soon. For now, we'll send a secure payment link when we confirm your session.]
booking.errorEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
booking.errorPhone: Please enter a phone number with the country code.
booking.errorContact: Please give an email or a phone number so we can confirm.
booking.errorServer: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again, or contact us on WhatsApp.
booking.errorSlotTaken: That time is no longer available. Please choose another.

confirmed.title: Thank you. Your request is in.
confirmed.lead: Taking this step matters. Here's what happens next.
confirmed.next1: We'll confirm your session by email or WhatsApp within [X hours].
confirmed.next2: You'll get a secure payment link and a link to join the session.
confirmed.next3: On the day, find a quiet, private spot. Headphones help.
confirmed.breathe: While you wait, take a breath with us
confirmed.noRef: We couldn't find a booking reference. If you've just booked, please check your email or contact us.
confirmed.demoNote: [Demo mode: email isn't set up yet, so no one has been notified of this request.]

aboutPage.metaDescription: Why we started an online counselling space for Malayalis, and what we stand for.
aboutPage.title: Care that speaks your language
aboutPage.lead: We started {brand} so that Malayalis, in Kerala and across the world, can talk to someone who understands not just their words, but where they come from.
aboutPage.story1: Many of us grew up hearing that worries are best kept inside the family, or handled quietly on our own. Asking for help can feel like a big step, especially when it has to happen in a second language.
aboutPage.story2: [Founder story: a few sentences, in your own words, on why you started this.]
aboutPage.v1Body: Feelings are easier to name in the language you grew up with. Every session can be in Malayalam, English or both.
aboutPage.v2Body: We collect only what we need, never sell data, and keep what you share between you and your therapist.
aboutPage.v3Body: Joint families, life abroad, faith, expectations: we understand the context you live in, without judging it.
aboutPage.v4Body: No quick fixes and no promises. Just steady, professional support at your pace.
aboutPage.trustLead: [Confirm: every therapist's qualifications and RCI registration are verified before they join.]
aboutPage.trust1: [Vetting process, e.g. minimum qualification, registration check, interview]
aboutPage.teamNote: [Founders and team: names, roles and photos, with their consent.]
aboutPage.whereBody: Sessions are online, so you can join from anywhere in Kerala, from Thiruvananthapuram to Kasaragod, or from wherever life has taken you.

businessPage.p1Body: Private one-to-one sessions your people book directly. You never see who booked or what was discussed.
businessPage.p2Body: Interactive sessions on stress, burnout, sleep, conflict and more, online or in person [if offered].
businessPage.p3Body: Help team leads notice when someone is struggling, and respond with care.
businessPage.p4Body: Counselling for students, with support for exam stress, homesickness and big transitions.
businessPage.p5Body: Practical guidance on supporting young people's mental health.
businessPage.privacyBody: Organisations receive only anonymised, combined usage figures, never names or anything said in a session.
